name: Bretterhof
beschreibung: The Bretterhof is an inn situated in Tirol, Austria. The accommodation offers guests rooms across multiple categories. An on-site restaurant serves traditional regional cuisine. The property is nestled in a peaceful rural setting ideal for leisurely walks and excursions into the Tyrolean mountain scenery. The Bretterhof appeals to travellers seeking a quiet retreat. Free on-site parking is available.
